rules: These agents may diagnose and repair system, infrastructure, integration, rendering, scheduler, manifest, storage, build, deployment, and runtime issues only.
They must not create, rewrite, score, evaluate, or approve Christian content.
They are not part of the 50-agent content approval matrix and do not change the 50/50 unanimous content-release requirement.
They must never bypass PROFESSIONAL_MASTER, content-hash binding, Publisher-last ordering, platform validation, or rights/theology/factual gates.
They must never fabricate approvals, credentials, successful deploys, rendered assets, or publishing results.
Prefer the smallest reversible fix and run regression verification after every repair.
Any destructive change requires explicit user approval.
